entities.name: Branislav Konrád

entities.summary: Branislav Konrád is a Slovak professional ice hockey goaltender for HC Olomouc of the Czech Extraliga and Slovakia. He previously played for HC Dukla Trenčín and HK Nitra in the Slovak Extraliga, and Metallurg Zhlobin in the Belarusian Extraleague.
